subject: MAP kickoff: draft milestones, owners & close-window options
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — initial draft + timeline options

Hi Samantha / Oliver,

Thanks again for your time on the discovery call today — good conversation and clear alignment on the business need for low-latency inference in your clinician-facing app. Per our discussion I attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a short bundle of discovery notes. The MAP is intentionally lightweight: it lists milestones, suggested owners, target close windows, and the known dependencies we flagged on the call.

Quick summary (please review and flag corrections):
- Milestones (proposed):
  1) Discovery sign-off (requirements & success metrics) — owner: Novus Product
  2) Pilot provisioning (private/policy config + infra) — owner: Redwood Platform (Aditya)
  3) Integration & test (API integration, data flow) — owner: Novus Engineering
  4) Evaluation & quality check (prompt & latency targets) — owner: Novus Product + Redwood PM
  5) Contract signature & procurement close — owner: Novus Procurement
- Target close windows (pick one):
  A) Accelerated: 6–8 weeks (tight, requires priority procurement and SOC2 docs)
  B) Standard: 10–12 weeks (allows procurement + security review cadence)
- Key dependencies:
  • Firewall/IP allowlist & egress rules (Novus infra)
  • SOC2 / security artifacts (we can share our SOC2 report and audit scope)
  • Data access for test account (redacted production or synthetic data)
  • Procurement timeline / PO lead time

Asks:
- Please confirm the internal stakeholder roster who will own the milestones (product, eng, security, procurement).
- Pick a preferred target close window (A or B) or propose an alternate date.
- Any additional dependencies we missed?

Next steps we propose once you confirm stakeholders: schedule a 45-minute MAP kickoff to align owners, call out critical path items, and lock a target close date. I included Marcus and Aditya on the CC — Aditya will own infra/provisioning tasks from our side.

Attachments: novus_MAP_initial_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), discovery-notes.pdf

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — initial draft + timeline options

Olga,

Thanks — the MAP draft looks like a good starting point. A few quick notes from our side:
- Confirmed internal owners: Samantha Lee (Product), Oliver Grant (CTO), Priya Shah (InfoSec), Teresa Cole (Procurement).
- We prefer target close date: end of Q3 — Sept 30, 2026. That aligns with our reporting cadence; if SOC2 evidence takes longer we may need to move to the Standard window.
- Dependencies to add: legal review of data processing terms (legal@novushealth.com) and our procurement requires a 2–3 week PO turnaround once terms are agreed.

Can you add a short row in the MAP that calls out "Procurement lead time: 2–3 weeks" and add a column for "legal review owner"? Also — Aditya, can your team confirm typical provisioning lead times for a dedicated pilot (GPU count and networking)?

Happy to do the kickoff next week — we're available Tue/Wed afternoons PT.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Senior Product Manager, Novus Health
Samantha.Lee@novushealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — initial draft + timeline options

Thanks — looping in a quick note on infra/provisioning timelines.
- For a dedicated pilot with the configuration we discussed (2 x A100-equivalent GPUs, private network peering), typical lead time is 7–10 business days from signed activation/PO and network details.
- I will own the "Pilot provisioning" milestone from Redwood's side and can provide a provisioning checklist (IP ranges, service account setup, KMS key policy).

I'll add the provisioning checklist to the MAP and share a short infra playbook before the kickoff.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Teresa Cole <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — initial draft + timeline options

Great — thanks for the confirmations and the preferred close date (Sept 30). I've updated the MAP to include: procurement lead time (2–3 weeks), legal review owner column, and a provisioning checklist row. Updated file: novus_MAP_initial_v2.xlsx (attached in the shared Drive).

Proposed next step: 45-minute MAP kickoff to align owners and call out the critical path items. Based on availability you sent, please pick one of these slots (all PT):
- Tue, Aug 26 2:00–2:45 PM
- Tue, Aug 26 3:30–4:15 PM
- Wed, Aug 27 1:30–2:15 PM

If none work, propose alternate windows and we'll adjust. I'll invite Marcus (platform lead) and Aditya (SE) from our side; please include Teresa (procurement) and Priya (InfoSec) on the calendar invite.

Link to updated MAP & notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEFgH-map-novus (view + comment). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-3941

Action items we will own before kickoff:
- Redwood: infra checklist + provisioning playbook (Aditya) — ETA: 48 hours
- Novus: confirm legal reviewer & procurement PO lead (Samantha / Teresa) — please confirm by EOD Mon

Thanks — looking forward to locking the timeline.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
